definition_zh: 内部的；体内的；国内的；内心的
definition_en: existing or happening inside a person, object, organization, or country rather than outside it
core_image: 一层外壳包着的内腔，所有零件都在壳里面转动
scene: 修车师傅打开引擎盖，用手电照进机件之间的缝里。The internal parts of the engine need a full check.
sceneCN: 这里 internal 是「内部的」（第 1 个义项：位于物体里侧的），句意为引擎的内部零件需要全面检查。画面里的物件：引擎盖、手电、齿轮。

pos.zh: 形容词：内部的；体内的；国内的；内心的

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「在内部；内心里」
由本词加 -ity 构成，义为「内在性」
以 extern- 词根加 -al 构成的反义词，义为「外部的」
由同一词根构成，义为「扣押；做实习医生」

senses.title: Inside an object
senses.definition: located or happening inside a physical object rather than on its surface
senses.definitionCN: 位于某个实物内部，而不在其表面上
senses.example: A crack in the internal wall went unnoticed for years.
senses.exampleCN: 内墙里的一道裂缝多年无人发现。
senses.why: Latin internus meant "inward" and was built on the same in- as in, inside.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 internus 意为「向内的」，和 in、inside 共用同一个 in-。

senses.title: Inside the body
senses.definition: relating to the organs and processes hidden within a living body
senses.definitionCN: 与活体内部隐藏的器官及其运作有关的
senses.example: The doctor worried about internal bleeding after the fall.
senses.exampleCN: 摔伤之后医生担心有内出血。
senses.why: Anatomy borrowed the spatial word: whatever lies beneath the skin is internal.
senses.whyCN: 解剖学借用了这个表示空间的词：皮肤底下的一切都叫 internal。

senses.title: Inside a country or group
senses.definition: belonging to the affairs of one country or organization, not involving outsiders
senses.definitionCN: 属于一个国家或组织自身事务、不涉及外部者的
senses.example: Internal trade rose while exports fell.
senses.exampleCN: 出口下降，国内贸易却增长了。
senses.why: Politics extended the shell metaphor to borders: things inside the border are internal.
senses.whyCN: 政治把这个「外壳」比喻扩展到国界：边界之内的事就是内部的。

senses.title: Inside the mind
senses.definition: existing in a person's private thoughts and feelings rather than being shown
senses.definitionCN: 存在于个人私下的想法与情感中而非表现出来的
senses.example: She fought an internal battle before answering the letter.
senses.exampleCN: 回那封信之前，她心里打了一场仗。
senses.why: The last step turns the word inward again, now to the mind rather than the body.
senses.whyCN: 最后一转又把词收回内部，只不过这回指心灵而非身体。

intro.en: Internal is a Latin adjective of location that English adopted whole in the sixteenth century.
intro.cn: internal 是拉丁语中表示位置的形容词，十六世纪被英语整体吸收。

items.en: The preposition in meant "in, within".
items.cn: 介词 in 意为「在……之中」。

items.en: From it came the adjective internus, "situated within".
items.cn: 由它产生形容词 internus，义为「位于内部的」。

items.en: English took internus through French forms as internal in the sciences.
items.cn: 英语经由法语形式把 internus 引入，并在科学文献中写作 internal。

items.en: Anatomy and law used internal for organs and for home affairs.
items.cn: 解剖学与法律分别用 internal 指内脏与内政。

items.en: Modern psychology added the inward, private sense of the mind.
items.cn: 现代心理学又添上「内心、私密」这一层意思。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the in- prefix; the near-meaning group holds words for what is hidden inside.
note.cn: 形近组共用 in- 前缀；近义组收表示「藏在里面」的词。

entries.definition: A trainee or, as a verb, to confine someone.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「实习生」，动词义为「扣押」。

entries.definition: The inside part of something, often of a building.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「内部」，常指房屋内部。

entries.definition: Very close and personal in relationship.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「亲密的」，指关系亲近。

entries.definition: The nearer of two parts; the mental or secret side.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「内部的；内心的」，偏口语。

entries.definition: Of the home or of one's own country.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「家里的；国内的」。

entries.definition: Kept out of sight on purpose or by accident.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「隐藏的」，强调看不见。

normalIntro.en: These hooks tie the word to things you already open up and look inside.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把它挂在你已经会拆开往里看的东西上。

normal.en: in- in internal is the same in- as in inside.
normal.cn: internal 里的 in- 和 inside 里的 in- 是同一个。

normal.en: Add -al and a place becomes a quality: inside, therefore internal.
normal.cn: 加 -al 把位置变成性质：在里面，所以是内部的。

normal.en: Internal organs are the ones you cannot see.
normal.cn: internal organs 就是那些你看不见的器官。

normal.en: An internal email goes to staff only.
normal.cn: internal email 只发给本单位的人。

normal.en: Its mirror twin is external, with ex- for outside.
normal.cn: 它的镜像词是 external，用 ex- 表示外面。

abstract.en: Internal means the shell is doing the hiding.
abstract.cn: internal 的意思是那层壳在替你遮蔽。

abstract.en: A country's internal affairs are its own conversation.
abstract.cn: 一国的内部事务是它自己的对话。

abstract.en: The mind has an internal weather only its owner feels.
abstract.cn: 心灵有一片只有本人才感觉得到的内部天气。

examples.en: The company held an internal review of the failed launch.
examples.cn: 公司对那次失败的发布做了内部复盘。

examples.en: Internal doors should be wide enough for a wheelchair.
examples.cn: 室内的门应宽到能过轮椅。

examples.en: He kept his internal doubts away from the team.
examples.cn: 他把心里的疑虑藏着，没让团队看出来。

dict_mnemonic.text: in（里面）+ tern + al——一切往「里」看都叫内部

root: 拉丁语 in「在内」→ internus「位于内部的」→ 英语 internal。反义为 external（ex-「在外」），同族有 intern、interior、internally。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: inside a thing, inside a body, inside a country or group, and inside a mind.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：物体之内、身体之内、一国或团体之内，以及内心之中。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: everything that stays behind the outer shell.
core.cn: 核心意象：留在外壳之内的一切。

branches.en: THE BOX: what lies within a physical object.
branches.cn: 盒子这条线：实物里侧的部分。

branches.en: THE BODY: organs kept under the skin.
branches.cn: 身体这条线：皮肤下面的器官。

branches.en: THE BORDER: affairs kept within one country.
branches.cn: 国界这条线：留在一国之内的政务。

branches.en: THE MIND: feelings never shown outside.
branches.cn: 心灵这条线：从未向外表露的情绪。

branches.en: THE LINK: both senses hide something behind a surface.
branches.cn: 连接线：两个义项都把东西藏在一个表面之后。

intro.en: Internal splits into the prefix in- "within", the stem intern-, and the adjective ending -al.
intro.cn: internal 可拆为前缀 in-「在内」、词干 intern- 与形容词词尾 -al。

latinIntro.en: Latin in and internus are recorded; the deeper root is shared with inside.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 in 与 internus 均有记载，更深层词根与 inside 同源。

items.example: The prefix marks the inside of a boundary.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀标出边界的内侧。

items.example: The stem carries the sense of location.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干承载位置意义。

items.example: It turns a place word into a quality.
items.exampleCN: 它把位置词变成性质词。

items.example: The adjective is the direct source.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词是直接来源。

items.example: The same stem names someone training inside a hospital.
items.exampleCN: 同一词干指在医院内部受训的人。

items.example: The comparative form of the same stem means the inner part.
items.exampleCN: 同一词干的比较级形式表示里侧。

items.example: It builds the opposite of in-.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 in- 的反义前缀。

items.example: The mirror word replaces in- with ex-.
items.exampleCN: 镜像词把 in- 换成了 ex-。

definition_zh: 国际的；国际性的；国际比赛
definition_en: involving two or more countries, or belonging to the whole world rather than one nation
core_image: 一张长桌，桌边插着好几面不同颜色的国旗
scene: 会议厅里长桌两侧坐着不同语言的代表，同声传译耳机排成一行。The treaty became international law after the vote.
sceneCN: 这里 international 是「国际的」（第 1 个义项：涉及多个国家的），句意为表决之后该条约成了国际法。画面里的物件：长桌、国旗、传译耳机。

pos.zh: 形容词：国际的；国际性的
名词：国际比赛；国际组织成员

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「在国际上」
由本词加 -ism 构成，义为「国际主义」
由本词加 -ize 构成，义为「使国际化」
去前缀 nation 加 -al 构成，义为「国家的」

senses.title: Between nations
senses.definition: existing or happening between two or more countries
senses.definitionCN: 存在于或发生在两个以上国家之间的
senses.example: Both sides signed an international agreement on fishing rights.
senses.exampleCN: 双方签署了一份关于捕鱼权的国际协议。
senses.why: The prefix inter- means between, so the word literally places something between nations.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 inter- 意为「之间」，所以这个词字面上就是把某物放在各国之间。

senses.title: Open to many countries
senses.definition: made up of or open to people and groups from many nations
senses.definitionCN: 由许多国家的人或团体组成、或向他们开放的
senses.example: The orchestra has an international cast of players.
senses.exampleCN: 这个乐团的演奏者来自许多国家。
senses.why: If something lies between nations, it naturally gathers people from all of them.
senses.whyCN: 既然位于各国之间，自然就会把各国的人都聚到一起。

senses.title: Competition or body
senses.definition: a match between national teams, or an organization with member states
senses.definitionCN: 国家代表队之间的比赛，或有成员国参加的组织
senses.example: He won three internationals before he turned twenty.
senses.exampleCN: 他二十岁前赢了三场国际比赛。
senses.why: As a noun the adjective needed no new shape: the games themselves became internationals.
senses.whyCN: 作名词时形容词不必变形：这类比赛就被叫作 internationals。

intro.en: International was coined in English in the late eighteenth century by adding inter- to national.
intro.cn: international 是十八世纪晚期英语在 national 前加 inter- 新造的词。

items.en: Inter meant "between" and nasci "to be born".
items.cn: inter 意为「之间」，nasci 意为「出生」。

items.en: Nation entered French from Latin natio, a people born together.
items.cn: nation 从拉丁语 natio「同出生的一群人」进入法语。

items.en: English used national for what belongs to one people.
items.cn: 英语用 national 表示属于一个民族或国家的。

items.en: Jeremy Bentham coined international for law that binds nations.
items.cn: 杰里米·边沁造出 international，指约束各国的法律。

items.en: From law the word spread to trade, sport, and organizations.
items.cn: 这个词从法律扩展到贸易、体育与各类组织。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the same inter- and nat- parts; the near-meaning group holds words about worldwide scale.
note.cn: 形近组共用 inter- 与 nat- 两部分；近义组收表示全球范围的词。

entries.definition: Belonging to one country only.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「国家的；民族的」，只属于一国。

entries.definition: Happening inside one country or object.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「内部的」，强调在内部。

entries.definition: A period of time between two events.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「间隔」，指两事之间的时间。

entries.definition: Covering the whole world as a single unit.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「全球的」，强调整体范围。

entries.definition: Spread through every part of the world.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「遍及全世界的」。

entries.definition: Operating in several countries at once.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「跨国的」，指同时在多国运作。

normalIntro.en: These hooks break the word into pieces you already know.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把它拆成你早已熟悉的几块。

normal.en: inter- means between; national means of a nation.
normal.cn: inter- 是「之间」，national 是「国家的」。

normal.en: Put them together: what sits between nations.
normal.cn: 合起来：坐在各国之间的东西。

normal.en: An international airport serves flights from other countries.
normal.cn: 国际机场接待来自别国的航班。

normal.en: Drop inter- and you are back to one country.
normal.cn: 去掉 inter- 就退回一个国家。

normal.en: The word was born in law, not in sport.
normal.cn: 这个词先在法律里出生，而不是体育。

abstract.en: International is the gap turned into a meeting room.
abstract.cn: 国际就是那道缝隙被改造成一间会议室。

abstract.en: A border is a line; international is what crosses it.
abstract.cn: 边界是一条线；国际是跨过这条线的一切。

abstract.en: Many flags, one word on the door.
abstract.cn: 许多面国旗，门牌上只写一个词。

examples.en: She works for an international charity in Geneva.
examples.cn: 她在日内瓦一家国际慈善机构工作。

examples.en: International calls cost extra on that plan.
examples.cn: 那个套餐里国际长途要另外收费。

examples.en: The match was his first international at this level.
examples.cn: 这场比赛是他在这一级别的首次国际赛事。

dict_mnemonic.text: inter（之间）+ nation（国家）+ al——国家之间的

root: 拉丁语 inter「之间」+ natio「出生、族群」→ 古法语 nation → 英语 national → 加 inter- 成 international。同族有 nation、national、internationally。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: between nations, made of many nations, and as a noun for big matches or bodies.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：国与国之间的、由多国组成的，以及作名词指国际赛事或组织。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a room where more than one flag stands at the table.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张桌边立着不止一面国旗的房间。

branches.en: THE TREATY: agreements that bind more than one state.
branches.cn: 条约这条线：约束不止一个国家的协定。

branches.en: THE TEAM: people drawn from many countries.
branches.cn: 团队这条线：来自许多国家的人。

branches.en: THE FIXTURE: a match or a body named for its scope.
branches.cn: 赛事这条线：以范围命名的比赛或组织。

branches.en: THE FRAME: both senses hang on what lies beyond one border.
branches.cn: 框架线：两个义项都挂在同一条边界之外。

branches.en: THE STAGE: a shared stage makes both the team and the match possible.
branches.cn: 舞台线：共用的舞台让团队与比赛都成为可能。

intro.en: International is inter- "between" plus national, where nat- means born.
intro.cn: international 是 inter-「之间」加 national，其中 nat- 意为「出生」。

latinIntro.en: Latin inter and natio are recorded; the verb nasci is the oldest member.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 inter 与 natio 均有记载，动词 nasci 是这一族最古老的成员。

items.example: It marks what sits between two sides.
items.exampleCN: 它标出位于两侧之间的东西。

items.example: The root also appears in native and nature.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也见于 native 与 nature。

items.example: The noun grew into the modern nation.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词演变成现代的 nation。

items.example: It makes national out of nation.
items.exampleCN: 它把 nation 变成 national。

items.example: The noun names one political community.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词指一个政治共同体。

items.example: The word adds inter- to this adjective.
items.exampleCN: 本词就是在这个形容词前加 inter-。

items.example: It forms internationally.
It forms internationalism.

definition_en: a period of work in a company or organization, often for a student, in order to gain experience
core_image: 一张写着名字的工作牌，压在办公桌一角，旁边是还没拆封的笔记本
scene: 毕业生把新办的门禁卡挂在胸前，在办公室的空位上坐下开始整理资料。Her summer internship turned into a full job offer.
sceneCN: 这里 internship 是「实习」（第 1 个义项：为获取经验的短期工作），句意为她的暑期实习最后变成了正式录用。画面里的物件：门禁卡、办公桌、资料夹。

pos.zh: 名词：实习；实习期；实习岗位

derivatives.zh: 去后缀 -ship 构成，义为「实习生」
由 intern 加 -ing 构成，义为「实习的过程」
同一后缀构成，义为「学徒期」

senses.title: A first taste of work
senses.definition: a job taken mainly to learn, usually for a fixed period and often by a student
senses.definitionCN: 主要为学习而承担的工作，通常有固定期限，多为学生去做
senses.example: His first real internship was in a hospital kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 他的第一份正经实习是在医院的厨房里。
senses.why: The suffix -ship means a state or role, so an internship is the condition of being an intern.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ship 表示状态或身份，所以 internship 就是「做 intern 的那段时光」。

senses.title: The period itself
senses.definition: the length of time during which someone works as an intern
senses.definitionCN: 某人做实习生所经历的那段时间
senses.example: The internship lasts twelve weeks with a review at the end.
senses.exampleCN: 这期实习持续十二周，结束时有一次评估。
senses.why: Time became as concrete as the job: the word names both the post and its run.
senses.whyCN: 时间变得和岗位一样具体：这个词同时指岗位和它的期限。

senses.title: A training step in a profession
senses.definition: a required supervised stage before full professional practice
senses.definitionCN: 正式执业之前必须经历的带督导训练阶段
senses.example: Medical internships keep young doctors under close watch.
senses.exampleCN: 医学实习让年轻医生处在密切看护之下。
senses.why: Law and medicine took the word over for the stage that makes someone fully qualified.
senses.whyCN: 法律与医学借用了这个词，指让人取得正式资格的那一段。

intro.en: Internship is an English coinage: the Latin-derived internal plus the native noun suffix -ship.
intro.cn: internship 是英语自造的：拉丁来源的 intern 加上本土名词后缀 -ship。

items.en: Internus "inner" described what lies within.
items.cn: internus「内部的」描述位于里侧的东西。

items.en: French interne named a doctor living inside a hospital.
items.cn: 法语 interne 指住在医院里的医生。

items.en: American English used intern for a graduate in training.
items.cn: 美式英语用 intern 指正在受训的毕业生。

items.en: -scipe was the native suffix for state or rank.
items.cn: 古英语的 -scipe 是表示状态或身份的本土后缀。

items.en: The two were joined in the early twentieth century as internship.
items.cn: 两者在二十世纪初合成 internship。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the intern stem; the near-meaning group holds other words for learning on the job.
note.cn: 形近组共用 intern 词干；近义组收其他表示「在工作中学习」的词。

entries.definition: Inside a thing, a body, or a country.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「内部的」。

entries.definition: The person doing such a period of work.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「实习生」。

entries.definition: The state of being friends.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「友谊」，共用 -ship 后缀。

entries.definition: Training under a skilled master for years.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「学徒期」，跟师傅学多年。

entries.definition: A paid training post, often in Europe.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「带薪培训岗位」。

entries.definition: A trial period watched by an employer or court.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「试用期；缓刑」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks connect the word to your own first days at a desk.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把它挂在你第一次坐进办公桌的那几天上。

normal.en: Intern plus -ship, the suffix of state, as in friendship.
normal.cn: intern 加 -ship，那个表示状态的后缀，如同 friendship。

normal.en: An intern is a person; an internship is the thing they go through.
normal.cn: intern 是人，internship 是他们经历的那件事。

normal.en: Summer internship is the phrase on every student's list.
normal.cn: summer internship 是每个学生清单上的词。

normal.en: The badge you wear is the sign of the internship.
normal.cn: 胸前那张工作牌就是实习的标志。

normal.en: -ship appears again in leadership and friendship.
normal.cn: -ship 还出现在 leadership 与 friendship 里。

abstract.en: An internship is a shadow before the real body arrives.
abstract.cn: 实习是真正上岗之前的一道影子。

abstract.en: It is a room you borrow so you can learn the trade.
abstract.cn: 那是你借用的房间，为的是学会这门手艺。

abstract.en: Practice, with a name tag.
abstract.cn: 练习，外加一张名牌。

examples.en: She found the internship through a friend of her mother.
examples.cn: 她通过母亲的一位朋友找到了这份实习。

examples.en: An internship at a newspaper taught him to write fast.
examples.cn: 在报社的实习教会他快速写稿。

examples.en: Unpaid internships became a topic of public debate.
examples.cn: 无薪实习成了公众讨论的话题。

dict_mnemonic.text: intern（实习生）+ ship（身份状态）——做实习生的那段身份

root: 拉丁语 internus「内部的」→ 法语 interne「驻院医生」→ 英语 intern，加本土后缀 -ship（状态、身份）成 internship。同族有 intern、internal、apprenticeship。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: the learning post, the period it lasts, and the required stage in a profession.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：学习性质的岗位、这段岗位持续的时间，以及专业执业前的必修阶段。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a borrowed desk where learning is the real salary.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张借来的桌子，真正的报酬是学到的本事。

branches.en: THE DESK: the first job taken to learn.
branches.cn: 书桌这条线：为学习而做的第一份工作。

branches.en: THE CALENDAR: the weeks the post lasts.
branches.cn: 日历这条线：这份岗位持续的周数。

branches.en: THE EXAM: the supervised stage before a licence.
branches.cn: 考试这条线：拿执照前的带督导阶段。

branches.en: THE LADDER: both senses sit on the way up to doing the job alone.
branches.cn: 阶梯线：两个义项都在通往独立执业的路上。

branches.en: THE CLOCK: training is measured out in fixed time.
branches.cn: 时钟线：训练总是按固定时长来计算。

intro.en: Internship pairs the Latin stem intern- "inside" with the Old English suffix -ship.
intro.cn: internship 把拉丁词干 intern-「在内」与古英语后缀 -ship 配在一起。

latinIntro.en: Latin internus and French interne are recorded; -ship is native Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 internus 与法语 interne 均有记载，而 -ship 是日耳曼语本土后缀。

items.example: It names someone living inside an institution.
items.exampleCN: 它指住在机构内部的人。

items.example: The suffix also builds friendship.
The noun is the base of the whole word.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词是整条词的基础。

items.example: The adjective supplied the stem.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干来自这个形容词。

items.example: The French form fixed the practical sense.
items.exampleCN: 法语形式定下了实用义。

items.example: It shows how -ship attaches to a noun.
items.exampleCN: 它示范了 -ship 如何接在名词后。

items.example: An apprenticeship is the older cousin.
items.exampleCN: apprenticeship 是它更年长的表亲。

items.example: The suffix works the same way here.
items.exampleCN: 后缀在这里起同样作用。

definition_en: to explain the meaning of something, to understand it in a particular way, or to translate speech aloud
core_image: 两个人隔着一道模糊的玻璃，中间站着一个人把话从一边递到另一边
scene: 会议室里，译员戴着耳机，把发言人刚说完的一段话轻声转成另一种语言。She had to interpret the silence as agreement.
sceneCN: 这里 interpret 是「解释、理解」（第 1 个义项：给含义作出说明），句意为她只好把那阵沉默理解成同意。画面里的物件：耳机、话筒、会议记录。

pos.zh: 动词：解释；理解；口译；演绎

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -er 构成，义为「口译员；解释者」
由本词加 -ation 构成，义为「解释；理解」
由本词加 -ive 构成，义为「解释性的」
由 mis- 加本词构成，义为「误解」

senses.title: Work out the meaning
senses.definition: to explain or decide what something means, especially something unclear
senses.definitionCN: 解释或判定某事物的含义，尤指不清楚的东西
senses.example: There are several ways to interpret this clause.
senses.exampleCN: 这一条款有好几种解释方式。
senses.why: Latin interpres was a go-between who explained one side to the other.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 interpres 是在两边之间替人解释的中间人。

senses.title: Read in a certain way
senses.definition: to understand an action or event in one particular way
senses.definitionCN: 以某一特定方式去理解某个动作或事件
senses.example: He interpreted her silence as refusal.
senses.exampleCN: 他把她沉默理解为拒绝。
senses.why: Once meaning is negotiable, the reader is the one who interprets.
senses.whyCN: 既然意义可以商量，做解释的就成了读者本人。

senses.title: Translate speech aloud
senses.definition: to translate spoken words from one language into another as they are said
senses.definitionCN: 在别人说话的同时把口头话语译成另一种语言
senses.example: She interpreted for the visiting minister all morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她整个上午为来访的部长做口译。
senses.why: The old go-between sense survives most literally here: the go-between still stands between two tongues.
senses.whyCN: 古老的中间人义在这里保留得最直接：中间人仍站在两种语言之间。

senses.title: Perform a role
senses.definition: to perform a piece of music or drama in a way that shows one's own understanding
senses.definitionCN: 以体现个人理解的方式演奏乐曲或演绎戏剧
senses.example: The quartet interpreted the slow movement very freely.
senses.exampleCN: 四重奏把那个慢乐章演绎得很自由。
senses.why: Performance adds a final twist: the player becomes the go-between of the composer.
senses.whyCN: 表演又添了最后一转：演奏者成了作曲家的中间人。

intro.en: Interpret comes from Latin interpres, a negotiator or go-between who explains each side to the other.
intro.cn: interpret 来自拉丁语 interpres，指为两边互相解释的谈判者或中间人。

items.en: Interpres named the middleman who carried words between parties.
items.cn: interpres 指在双方之间传递话语的中间人。

items.en: The verb interpretari meant to explain or negotiate.
items.cn: 动词 interpretari 意为「解释；谈判」。

items.en: Old French interpreter narrowed it towards explaining meaning.
items.cn: 古法语 interpreter 把它收窄到「解释含义」。

items.en: English used interpret for dreams, texts, and laws.
items.cn: 英语用 interpret 指解梦、解文、释法。

items.en: With live translation the word also took on the spoken sense.
items.cn: 随着现场翻译出现，这个词又添上口译义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the inter- prefix and its noun forms; the near-meaning group holds words about explaining.
note.cn: 形近组共用 inter- 前缀及其名词形式；近义组收表示「说明」的词。

entries.definition: The explanation or reading that results.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「解释；解读」。

entries.definition: The person who translates speech aloud.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「口译员」。

entries.definition: To break in on someone who is speaking.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「打断」，拼写相近。

entries.definition: To make something clear in plain words.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「解释清楚」。

entries.definition: To put words of one language into another.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「翻译」，书面与口头都可用。

entries.definition: To grasp what something means.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「理解」的内心动作。

normalIntro.en: These hooks put the go-between back at the centre of the word.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把「中间人」重新放回这个词的中心。

normal.en: inter- is between; an interpreter stands between two speakers.
normal.cn: inter- 是「之间」；口译员就站在两个说话人之间。

normal.en: To interpret a dream is to translate it into plain sense.
normal.cn: 解梦就是把它翻译成明白的道理。

normal.en: Interpret the look as a hint, and reading becomes a habit.
normal.cn: 把眼神也当成线索去读，阅读就成了习惯。

normal.en: The noun pile grows: interpreter, interpretation, interpretive.
normal.cn: 名词家族壮大：interpreter、interpretation、interpretive。

normal.en: Mis- at the front turns interpret into getting it wrong.
normal.cn: 前面加 mis- 就变成理解错了。

abstract.en: Interpretation is a bridge that only holds one passenger at a time.
abstract.cn: 解释是一座一次只能过一位行人的桥。

abstract.en: Every interpreter lends the speaker a borrowed voice.
abstract.cn: 每个译员都借给说话人一副嗓子。

abstract.en: Meaning does not travel; someone has to carry it.
abstract.cn: 意义不会自己走，总得有人去搬。

examples.en: Good readers interpret a poem before they judge it.
examples.cn: 好的读者先理解一首诗，再评判它。

examples.en: Nobody should interpret a shrug as a yes.
examples.cn: 谁都不该把一个耸肩当成同意。

examples.en: She learned to interpret between Chinese and Spanish.
examples.cn: 她学会了在中西两种语言之间做口译。

dict_mnemonic.text: inter（之间）+ pret（说清楚）——在两边之间把话说明白

root: 拉丁语 interpres「中间人、谈判者」→ interpretari「解释」→ 古法语 interpreter → 英语 interpret。同族有 interpreter、interpretation、misinterpret。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: explain a meaning, read something a certain way, translate speech live, and perform a work.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：阐明含义、按某种方式理解、现场口译，以及演绎作品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person standing in the gap between two sides and carrying words across.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人站在两方之间的缝里，把话搬过对面。

branches.en: THE GLOSS: making an unclear meaning plain.
branches.cn: 注解这条线：把不清楚的含义讲清楚。

branches.en: THE LENS: every reader puts on a way of seeing.
branches.cn: 透镜这条线：每个读者都戴上一副看法。

branches.en: THE EARPIECE: words carried live across languages.
branches.cn: 耳机这条线：话语被当场搬过语言边界。

branches.en: THE STAGE: the player speaks for the composer.
branches.cn: 舞台这条线：演奏者替作曲家说话。

branches.en: THE LINK: both senses make one meaning reach another person.
branches.cn: 连接线：两个义项都让一种意思抵达另一个人。

intro.en: Interpret holds the prefix inter- "between" and an old Latin stem pret- of uncertain meaning.
intro.cn: interpret 含前缀 inter-「之间」与一个含义不确定的拉丁词干 pret-。

latinIntro.en: Latin interpres and interpretari are recorded; the inner stem is debated by scholars.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 interpres 与 interpretari 均有记载，其内部词干学者有争议。

items.example: It places the action between two parties.
items.exampleCN: 它把动作放在两方之间。

items.example: The stem is debated among etymologists.
items.exampleCN: 词源学者对这个词干有争论。

items.example: The noun is the oldest secure form.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词是现存最古老可靠的形式。

items.example: The verb is the direct source.
It forms interpreter.
It forms interpretation.
It forms misinterpret.
It forms interpretive.

definition_en: an explanation of what something means, a particular way of understanding it, or a performance that shows one's reading
core_image: 同一段旧文字，旁边密密麻麻写着不同颜色的批注，每一层都是一种读法
scene: 学生把同一行诗抄了三遍，每一遍旁边写下自己不同的想法。Her interpretation of the contract was stricter than his.
sceneCN: 这里 interpretation 是「解释、理解」（第 1 个义项：对含义的说明），句意为她对合同的解释比他更严格。画面里的物件：诗稿、彩色批注、放大镜。

pos.zh: 名词：解释；理解；演绎；口译

collocations.phrase: a fresh interpretation of a play

derivatives.zh: 去后缀构成，义为「解释；口译」
由 interpret 加 -ive 构成，义为「解释性的」
由 interpret 加 -er 构成，义为「口译员」
加前缀 mis- 构成，义为「误解」

senses.title: An explanation offered
senses.definition: a statement that explains what something means or how it should be understood
senses.definitionCN: 说明某事物含义或应当如何理解的陈述
senses.example: The guide gave a short interpretation of each symbol.
senses.exampleCN: 讲解员对每个符号都作了简短解释。
senses.why: The Latin -atio turned the act of explaining into a thing you can hand to another.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 -atio 把「解释」这个动作变成可以递给别人的东西。

senses.title: A personal reading
senses.definition: the particular way a person understands a text, event, or action
senses.definitionCN: 某个人理解文本、事件或动作的特定方式
senses.example: Her interpretation of the results differed from the lab's.
senses.exampleCN: 她对结果的解读与实验室的不同。
senses.why: Once explanation is a thing, it can differ from person to person.
senses.whyCN: 解释一旦成了具体的东西，就可能因人而异。

senses.title: A performance
senses.definition: a way of performing a piece of music or drama that reveals the performer's understanding
senses.definitionCN: 体现表演者理解的演奏或戏剧呈现方式
senses.example: The director's interpretation set the play in a factory.
senses.exampleCN: 导演的演绎把这部戏搬进了一家工厂。
senses.why: Performance continued the older sense: the player interprets the work as a text.
senses.whyCN: 表演延续了旧义：演奏者把作品当文本去解释。

senses.title: Live translation
senses.definition: the act of translating speech from one language into another as it happens
senses.definitionCN: 在讲话进行的同时把话语译成另一种语言的活动
senses.example: Simultaneous interpretation requires intense concentration.
senses.exampleCN: 同声传译需要高度专注。
senses.why: The go-between sense of the base verb lives on in this technical noun.
senses.whyCN: 原动词的「中间人」义在这个专业名词里延续下来。

intro.en: Interpretation is the Latin noun of result built on interpretari, the work of a go-between.
intro.cn: interpretation 是建立在 interpretari（中间人的工作）之上的拉丁语结果名词。

items.en: Interpres named the person who carried meaning between parties.
items.cn: interpres 指在双方之间传递含义的人。

items.en: Interpretatio was the explaining that such a person produced.
items.cn: interpretatio 是这类人所做出的解释。

items.en: French interpretation kept the sense of expounding a text.
items.cn: 法语 interpretation 保留了阐述文本的意思。

items.en: The word entered English with law, scripture, and dreams.
items.cn: 这个词随法律、经文与解梦进入英语。

items.en: Modern usage adds performance and conference translation.
items.cn: 现代用法又添上表演与会议翻译。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the interpret- stem; the near-meaning group holds other names for an explanation.
note.cn: 形近组共用 interpret- 词干；近义组收其他表示「说明」的名词。

entries.definition: The verb of explaining or translating.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「解释；口译」。

entries.definition: The person doing it, not the result.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「口译员」，指人而非结果。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning explanatory.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「解释性的」。

entries.definition: The act of making something clear.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「说明」，强调说清楚。

entries.definition: One person's version of what a text means.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「解读」，偏个人理解。

entries.definition: One account of an event among several.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「一种说法」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks work best with the verb interpret, which the noun simply turns into a thing.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子最好和动词 interpret 搭配，名词只是把它变成了一件东西。

normal.en: -ation turns the act into a product: interpret, interpretation.
normal.cn: -ation 把动作变成产物：interpret、interpretation。

normal.en: An interpretation is something you can write down and hand over.
normal.cn: 解释是能写下来、递出去的东西。

normal.en: Two people can hold two interpretations of one sentence.
normal.cn: 一句话可以有两个人各自的解释。

normal.en: Simultaneous interpretation happens in a glass booth.
normal.cn: 同声传译发生在玻璃隔间里。

normal.en: A director's interpretation changes what you see on stage.
normal.cn: 导演的演绎会改变你在台上看到的东西。

abstract.en: A text is a room; an interpretation is the furniture you bring in.
abstract.cn: 文本是一间房，解释是你搬进去的家具。

abstract.en: Every reading leaves fingerprints on the page.
abstract.cn: 每种读法都会在纸上留下指纹。

abstract.en: Meaning is not found; it is handed to you by a reader.
abstract.cn: 含义不是被找到的，是某个读者递给你的。

examples.en: The judge's interpretation of the rule surprised both sides.
examples.cn: 法官对规则的解释让双方都很意外。

examples.en: Her interpretation of the role was quieter than the usual one.
examples.cn: 她对这个角色的演绎比通常的更安静。

examples.en: Their interpretation of the data has been challenged.
examples.cn: 他们对数据的解读受到了质疑。

dict_mnemonic.text: interpret（解释）+ ation（结果）——解释出来的那套说法

root: 拉丁语 interpres「中间人」→ interpretari「解释」→ interpretatio「解释的产物」→ 古法语 → 英语 interpretation。同族有 interpret、interpreter、interpretive。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: an offered explanation, a personal reading, a staged performance, and live translation.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：给出的解释、个人的读法、舞台上的演绎，以及现场口译。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a page covered in coloured notes, each colour a different reader.
core.cn: 核心意象：一页纸上写满各色批注，每种颜色都是一位读者。

branches.en: THE NOTE: the explanation you can hand over.
branches.cn: 便条这条线：可以递出去的解释。

branches.en: THE GLASSES: the reader's own way of seeing.
branches.cn: 眼镜这条线：读者自己的看法。

branches.en: THE STAGE: a work shown through one mind.
branches.cn: 舞台这条线：经由一个人头脑呈现的作品。

branches.en: THE BOOTH: speech carried across languages.
branches.cn: 隔间这条线：话语被搬过语言边界。

branches.en: THE EAR: both senses begin with hearing a meaning first.
branches.cn: 耳朵线：两个义项都先要听见一种含义。

intro.en: Interpretation is interpret plus the Latin noun ending -ation, which names an act or its result.
intro.cn: interpretation 是 interpret 加拉丁名词词尾 -ation，表示行为或其结果。

latinIntro.en: Latin interpretatio and interpretari are recorded forms of this family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 interpretatio 与 interpretari 都是这一族的记载形式。

items.example: It marks the go-between position.
The oldest form in the family.
items.exampleCN: 这一族中最古老的形式。

items.exampleCN: 整个词干来自这个动词。

definition_en: to break in on someone who is speaking or doing something, or to stop something from continuing
core_image: 一条拉直的线被剪刀从中间剪断，两头各自翘起
scene: 会议进行到一半，门被推开，有人急着插话报告消息。Sorry to interrupt, but the train has been cancelled.
sceneCN: 这里 interrupt 是「打断」（第 1 个义项：插进别人正在说的话里），句意为抱歉打扰，但那班火车已取消。画面里的物件：半开的门、会议桌、手机。

pos.zh: 动词：打断；中断；妨碍

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ion 构成，义为「中断；打扰」
由过去分词转作形容词，义为「被打断的」
加前缀 un- 构成，义为「不间断的」
同一词根 rumpere 构成，义为「突然的」

senses.title: Break into speech
senses.definition: to start speaking while someone else is still talking
senses.definitionCN: 在别人还在说话时开口插话
senses.example: Please do not interrupt while the witness is answering.
senses.exampleCN: 证人回答时请不要打断。
senses.why: Latin rumpere means to break; inter- means between, so the word breaks in between.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 rumpere 意为「折断」，inter- 意为「之间」，合起来就是「从中间插进去」。

senses.title: Stop a process
senses.definition: to cause an activity or process to stop before it is finished
senses.definitionCN: 使某项活动或过程在完成前停止
senses.example: Heavy snow interrupted the power supply for two days.
senses.exampleCN: 大雪使供电中断了两天。
senses.why: The break image moves from conversation to machinery and weather.
senses.whyCN: 「折断」的图像从对话转到机器与天气上。

senses.title: Block a view or line
senses.definition: to block something that would otherwise be continuous, such as a view or a path
senses.definitionCN: 遮断本来是连续的东西，如视线或通路
senses.example: A new tower interrupts the view from the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 一座新楼挡住了从桥上望出去的景色。
senses.why: Anything that cuts a line counts as an interruption, even in space.
senses.whyCN: 凡是把一条线切断的事都算打断，即使发生在空间里。

intro.en: Interrupt is built from Latin inter- "between" and rumpere "to break".
intro.cn: interrupt 由拉丁语 inter-「之间」与 rumpere「折断」构成。

items.en: Rumpere meant to break or burst a solid thing.
items.cn: rumpere 意为折断或使坚硬之物破裂。

items.en: Interrumpere meant to break something in the middle.
items.cn: interrumpere 意为从中间把某物折断。

items.en: The participle interruptus described a broken-off state.
items.cn: 分词 interruptus 描述被切断的状态。

items.en: English borrowed interrupt in the fifteenth century for broken speech.
items.cn: 英语十五世纪借入 interrupt，指被打断的话语。

items.en: The word spread to power, travel, and any halted process.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到供电、交通以及一切被停下的过程。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -rupt root; the near-meaning group holds other ways of cutting in.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -rupt 词根；近义组收其他「插进来」的说法。

entries.definition: The act or an instance of breaking in.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「中断；插话」。

entries.definition: To burst out, as a volcano does.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「爆发」，同出 rumpere。

entries.definition: Rotten or dishonest, literally broken through.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「腐败的」，字面是「被彻底破坏」。

entries.definition: To trouble someone's quiet or work.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「打扰」，强调扰乱安宁。

entries.definition: To join a conversation without being asked.
entries.definitionCN: 动词短语义为「插话」。

entries.definition: To stop suddenly in the middle.
entries.definitionCN: 动词短语义为「突然中断」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep the picture of a line snapped in two.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子守着「一条线被剪成两截」的画面。

normal.en: inter- between plus rupt break equals breaking in between.
normal.cn: inter-「之间」加 rupt「折断」等于从中间插断。

normal.en: A rupt root shows up in erupt and corrupt too.
normal.cn: rupt 词根也出现在 erupt 与 corrupt 里。

normal.en: Sorry to interrupt is the polite door knock of speech.
normal.cn: sorry to interrupt 是话语世界里礼貌的敲门声。

normal.en: An uninterrupted film runs from start to end.
normal.cn: uninterrupted 的影片从头放到尾。

normal.en: Snow can interrupt a journey far more rudely than a person.
normal.cn: 雪比人更不讲礼地打断一段行程。

abstract.en: An interruption is a line that refuses to stay straight.
abstract.cn: 打断就是一条不肯保持笔直的线。

abstract.en: Every conversation is two people taking turns not to snap.
abstract.cn: 每场对话都是两个人轮流克制着不去剪断。

abstract.en: To interrupt is to borrow time you have not been given.
abstract.cn: 打断是借用一段没人给你的时间。

examples.en: She interrupted his story to ask a question.
examples.cn: 她打断他的讲述，问了一个问题。

examples.en: The strike interrupted production for three weeks.
examples.cn: 罢工使生产中断了三周。

examples.en: Do not interrupt the machine while it is updating.
examples.cn: 机器更新时不要中断它。

dict_mnemonic.text: inter（之间）+ rupt（断）——从中间把它断开

root: 拉丁语 inter「之间」+ rumpere「折断」→ interrumpere「从中间打断」→ 英语 interrupt。同族有 interruption、erupt、corrupt。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: break into speech, stop a process, and cut across a view or path.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：插话、中断过程、遮断视线或通路。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a straight line cut in the middle by a scissor.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条直线被剪刀从中间剪开。

branches.en: THE VOICE: one speaker cutting into another.
branches.cn: 嗓音这条线：一个人插进另一个人的话。

branches.en: THE MACHINE: a process stopped before its end.
branches.cn: 机器这条线：过程在结束前被停住。

branches.en: THE VIEW: something placed across a line of sight.
branches.cn: 视线这条线：有东西横在目光前面。

branches.en: THE LINK: both senses break a flow that was running.
branches.cn: 连接线：两个义项都截断了一股正在流动的东西。

branches.en: THE BARRIER: stopping and blocking share the same snap.
branches.cn: 屏障线：停止与遮挡共用同一次折断。

intro.en: Interrupt is inter- "between" plus the Latin root rupt- "break".
intro.cn: interrupt 是 inter-「之间」加拉丁词根 rupt-「折断」。

latinIntro.en: Latin rumpere, interrumpere and the participle interruptus are all recorded.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 rumpere、interrumpere 与分词 interruptus 均有记载。

items.example: It puts the break in the middle.
The root also lives in rupture.
The verb is the base of the root.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是词根的基础。

items.example: The participle gave the English verb its shape.
items.exampleCN: 这个分词给了英语动词形式。

items.example: It forms interruption.
It forms uninterrupted.
It forms erupt, bursting outward.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 erupt，意为向外爆出。

items.example: It forms corrupt, thoroughly broken.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 corrupt，意为被彻底毁坏。

definition_zh: 中断；打扰；打断的话；障碍
definition_en: the act of breaking in on something, a remark that breaks in, or a pause that stops a process
core_image: 会议记录上多出一行横线，把原本连贯的句子拦腰截断
scene: 孩子在书房门外探头，问了一句作业题，父亲只好放下笔。After one interruption the speaker began again from the top.
sceneCN: 这里 interruption 是「打扰、打断」（第 1 个义项：打断别人的动作），句意为被打断一次之后，讲话者从头再讲。画面里的物件：门缝、作业本、笔。

pos.zh: 名词：中断；打扰；打断的话；障碍物

derivatives.zh: 去后缀构成，义为「打断；中断」
由过去分词构成，义为「被打断的」
加前缀 un- 构成，义为「不间断的」

senses.title: The act of cutting in
senses.definition: the act of breaking in on someone who is speaking or working
senses.definitionCN: 在别人说话或做事时插进来的动作
senses.example: He raised one hand to beg an interruption.
senses.exampleCN: 他举起一只手，请求插一句话。
senses.why: The noun names the snap itself, not the person who made it.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词指那一次折断，而不指造成折断的人。

senses.title: A pause in a process
senses.definition: a break that stops an activity for a while and then lets it go on
senses.definitionCN: 使活动暂停一段再继续的间断
senses.example: Work continued for six hours without interruption.
senses.exampleCN: 工作持续了六个小时没有间断。
senses.why: Time made the break measurable: an interruption is now a gap on a clock.
senses.whyCN: 时间让这道断裂变得可以计量：中断成了钟表上的空档。

senses.title: A breaking remark
senses.definition: a remark or question that cuts into what someone else is saying
senses.definitionCN: 插进别人话语中的一句话或问题
senses.example: His interruptions made the lecture hard to follow.
senses.exampleCN: 他不断的插话让讲座难以跟上。
senses.why: From the act came the content: the words themselves are also interruptions.
senses.whyCN: 从动作派生出内容：那些话本身也被叫作 interruptions。

intro.en: Interruption is the Latin action noun built on interrumpere, to break in the middle.
intro.cn: interruption 是建立在 interrumpere（从中间打断）之上的拉丁语动作名词。

items.en: Rumpere meant to break a solid thing apart.
items.cn: rumpere 意为把坚硬之物折断。

items.en: Interruptio named the breaking of a continuous thing.
items.cn: interruptio 指打断一件连续之物。

items.en: Old French kept the noun for a break in speech.
items.cn: 古法语保留了这个名词，指话语中的打断。

items.en: English used interruption for halted talk, work, and travel.
items.cn: 英语用 interruption 指被打断的谈话、工作与行程。

items.en: Technology gave it the modern sense of service outage.
items.cn: 技术发展又添上「服务中断」这一现代义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -rupt stem; the near-meaning group holds other words for a break.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -rupt 词干；近义组收其他表示间断的词。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to break in.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「打断」。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning tending to interrupt.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「打断性的」，与 interruption 拼写相近。

entries.definition: A bursting out, as of a volcano.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「喷发」，同出 rumpere。

entries.definition: Something that upsets peace or order.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「干扰；骚乱」。

entries.definition: A pause between periods of activity.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「休息；间断」。

entries.definition: A short stop with the intention to continue.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「停顿」，暗示还要继续。

normalIntro.en: These hooks turn the verb into something you can count on your fingers.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把动词变成能掰着手指数出来的东西。

normal.en: Add -ion to interrupt and the act becomes a countable event.
normal.cn: interrupt 加 -ion，动作就变成可数的事件。

normal.en: One interruption, two interruptions: each is a broken line.
normal.cn: 一次打断、两次打断：每一次都是一条断线。

normal.en: Without interruption is the wish behind every deep work session.
normal.cn: without interruption 是每次深度工作背后的心愿。

normal.en: An interruption to traffic annoys drivers more than a red light.
normal.cn: an interruption to traffic 比红灯更让司机恼火。

normal.en: Excuse the interruption is the apology before the cut.
normal.cn: excuse the interruption 是动刀前的道歉。

abstract.en: An interruption is a door someone opens in your sentence.
abstract.cn: 打断是有人在你句子里开了一扇门。

abstract.en: A day of interruptions is a day written in fragments.
abstract.cn: 被不断打断的一天，是用碎片写成的一天。

abstract.en: The noun weighs what the verb did.
abstract.cn: 这个名词替动词记下了那道切口的分量。

examples.en: The talk went on for forty minutes free of any interruption.
examples.cn: 讲座进行了四十分钟，一次也没被打断。

examples.en: Power interruptions left the street dark for a whole evening.
examples.cn: 停电让整条街黑了一整晚。

examples.en: Excuse the interruption, but the taxi is waiting.
examples.cn: 原谅我插一句，出租车已经在等了。

dict_mnemonic.text: interrupt（打断）+ ion（名词）——打断这件事本身

root: 拉丁语 rumpere「折断」→ interrumpere「从中间打断」→ interruptio「中断」→ 古法语 → 英语 interruption。同族有 interrupt、interrupted、uninterrupted。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: the act of cutting in, a pause in a process, and the remark that does the cutting.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：插进来的动作、过程中的停顿，以及插进来的那句话。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one stroke across a written sentence, cutting it in two.
core.cn: 核心意象：一句写好的话被一道横线拦腰截开。

branches.en: THE HAND: the raised hand that asks to cut in.
branches.cn: 举手这条线：请求插话的动作。

branches.en: THE CLOCK: hours run without a gap.
branches.cn: 时钟这条线：不间断的连续时段。

branches.en: THE WORD: the question itself that breaks the flow.
branches.cn: 话语这条线：打断连贯的那句问话。

branches.en: THE LINK: a cut and the words that made it belong together.
branches.cn: 连接线：那道切口与造成它的话是同一条线。

branches.en: THE COST: every remark costs the listener some minutes.
branches.cn: 代价线：每句插话都要让听者付出一段时间。

intro.en: Interruption is inter- plus the root rupt- "break" and the noun ending -ion.
intro.cn: interruption 由 inter- 加词根 rupt-「折断」与名词词尾 -ion 构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin interruptio and rumpere are recorded; the family also gives English eruption.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 interruptio 与 rumpere 均有记载，这一族也给英语带来 eruption。

items.example: It sets the break in the middle.
The root runs through rupture and abrupt.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根贯穿 rupture 与 abrupt。

items.example: The noun is the direct source.
It makes the verb into a noun.
The verb is the base of the noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是名词的基础。

items.example: It forms interrupted.
It forms uninterrupted.
It forms abrupt, broken away suddenly.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 abrupt，意为突然断开。

definition_en: a period of time between two events, or a space between two things
core_image: 两根柱子之间空出一段距离，阳光正好落在中间那块地面上
scene: 公交车每隔十分钟来一辆，站台上的人看着时刻表估摸下一班。There was a long interval before the doctor came out.
sceneCN: 这里 interval 是「间隔」（第 1 个义项：两个事件之间的时间段），句意为过了很久医生才出来。画面里的物件：时刻表、站台长椅、手表。

pos.zh: 名词：间隔；间歇；幕间休息

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ic 构成，义为「间隔的；音程的」
结构相近的近亲，义为「幕间插曲」

senses.title: Time between events
senses.definition: the length of time separating two events or points
senses.definitionCN: 把两个事件或两个时点隔开的那段时间
senses.example: Buses run here at intervals of fifteen minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 这里的公交车每十五分钟一班。
senses.why: Latin intervallum meant the space between rampart walls.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 intervallum 本指城墙之间的空地。

senses.title: Space between things
senses.definition: the distance or empty space between two objects placed apart
senses.definitionCN: 两件分开放置之物之间的距离或空隙
senses.example: Plant the young trees at wide intervals.
senses.exampleCN: 树苗要按较宽的间距栽种。
senses.why: The word began with space, so this sense is the older picture returning.
senses.whyCN: 这个词本来讲空间，所以这一义项是更古老的画面回来了。

senses.title: A break in a show
senses.definition: a pause between the parts of a performance, when the audience may leave their seats
senses.definitionCN: 演出各部分之间的暂停，观众可以离座
senses.example: We talked about the play during the interval.
senses.exampleCN: 中场休息时我们聊了聊这部戏。
senses.why: A theatre simply uses the time sense for its own calendar of acts.
senses.whyCN: 剧院只是把时间义用在自己分幕的日程上。

senses.title: A gap in pitch
senses.definition: the distance in pitch between two musical notes
senses.definitionCN: 两个音之间在音高上的距离
senses.example: A fifth is the easiest interval to hear.
senses.exampleCN: 五度是最容易听出来的音程。
senses.why: Music measures distance too, so the space word works between notes.
senses.whyCN: 音乐也丈量距离，于是空间词也能用在音符之间。

intro.en: Interval comes from Latin intervallum, the space between two palisades of a camp.
intro.cn: interval 来自拉丁语 intervallum，指军营两道栅栏之间的空地。

items.en: Vallum was the wall of stakes round a camp.
items.cn: vallum 是营寨四周的木桩墙。

items.en: Intervallum was the open space left between walls.
items.cn: intervallum 是两道墙之间留出的空地。

items.en: The word also measured gaps in time and in speech.
items.cn: 这个词也用来量时间与话语中的空档。

items.en: French intervalle carried the spacing sense to English.
items.cn: 法语 intervalle 把「间距」义带入英语。

items.en: Theatres and musicians gave the word its break and pitch senses.
items.cn: 剧院与音乐家又给它添上休息与音程义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the inter- prefix; the near-meaning group holds words for gaps.
note.cn: 形近组共用 inter- 前缀；近义组收表示空档的词。

entries.definition: Situated inside something.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「内部的」。

entries.definition: Necessary as part of a whole.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「不可缺少的」，拼写相近。

entries.definition: A short piece played between acts.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「幕间曲；插曲」。

entries.definition: An empty space or a missing part.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「缺口；空档」。

entries.definition: A short stop before carrying on.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「停顿」。

entries.definition: A rest between periods of activity.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「休息；间歇」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep the picture of two posts with a measured gap between them.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子守着「两根柱子之间量出一段空档」的画面。

normal.en: inter- between plus vallum wall gives the space between walls.
normal.cn: inter-「之间」加 vallum「墙」就是两墙之间的空地。

normal.en: At regular intervals is the phrase of clocks and buses.
normal.cn: at regular intervals 是钟表和公交的说法。

normal.en: The interval in a play is exactly a gap in the action.
normal.cn: 戏里的 interval 正是情节中间的空档。

normal.en: Musicians count the interval between two notes.
normal.cn: 音乐家数两个音之间的音程。

normal.en: Interval, not Internet: the middle letters are -erv- not -ernet-.
normal.cn: 是 interval 不是 internet：中间是 -erv- 而非 -ernet-。

abstract.en: An interval is silence given a length.
abstract.cn: 间隔就是被量出长度的沉默。

abstract.en: Two notes need the empty air between them to become music.
abstract.cn: 两个音要有中间的空处才成为音乐。

abstract.en: Life is measured in intervals as much as in events.
abstract.cn: 人生不只由事件计量，也由事件之间的间隔计量。

examples.en: The nurse checked his pulse at short intervals.
examples.cn: 护士每隔一小会儿就看一次他的脉搏。

examples.en: There is a wide interval between their two houses.
examples.cn: 他们两家的房子之间隔着很大的距离。

examples.en: During the interval the orchestra stayed on stage.
examples.cn: 幕间休息时乐队留在台上。

dict_mnemonic.text: inter（之间）+ val（墙）——两墙之间空出来的那段

root: 拉丁语 vallum「木桩墙」→ intervallum「两墙之间的空地」→ 古法语 intervalle → 英语 interval。同族有 intervallic、interlude。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: time between events, space between objects, a break in a show, and pitch distance in music.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：事件之间的时间、物体之间的空间、演出中间的休息，以及音乐中的音程。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two posts, and the measured empty ground between them.
core.cn: 核心意象：两根柱子，中间量出的一段空地。

branches.en: THE TICKET: the wait before the next bus.
branches.cn: 车票这条线：下一班车之前的等待。

branches.en: THE FIELD: the distance planted between two trees.
branches.cn: 田地这条线：两棵树之间留出的距离。

branches.en: THE CURTAIN: the pause between two acts.
branches.cn: 幕布这条线：两幕之间的暂停。

branches.en: THE SOUND: the gap that makes two notes a melody.
branches.cn: 声音这条线：让两个音成曲的距离。

branches.en: THE LINK: the same gap, read on a clock or on the ground.
branches.cn: 连接线：同一个空档，或读作时间或读作地面。

intro.en: Interval is inter- "between" plus Latin vallum "rampart", with the noun ending lost in French.
intro.cn: interval 是 inter-「之间」加拉丁语 vallum「壁垒」，名词词尾在法语中磨掉了。

latinIntro.en: Latin vallum and intervallum are recorded; the root also gives English wall.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 vallum 与 intervallum 均有记载，这个词根也给英语带来 wall。

items.example: It marks the space of two sides.
items.exampleCN: 它标出两侧之间的空处。

items.example: The root survives in English wall.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根在英语 wall 中留存。

items.example: The noun named the camp wall.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词指营寨的围墙。

items.example: The noun is the direct source.
French trimmed the Latin ending.
It forms intervallic.

items.meaning: a side of a building or fort
items.example: It keeps the old root alive.
Another inter- word of the same pattern.
items.exampleCN: 同一模式的另一个 inter- 词。

definition_en: to become involved in a situation in order to change it, or to come between two things
core_image: 两个人正吵着，一只手从中间伸进来把他们隔开
scene: 楼下两人越吵越凶，邻居从门里出来站在他们中间劝架。The teacher intervened before the quarrel turned into a fight.
sceneCN: 这里 intervene 是「干预」（第 1 个义项：介入以改变局面），句意为老师赶在争吵变成打架之前介入了。画面里的物件：楼梯口、半开的门、伸出的手臂。

pos.zh: 动词：干预；介入；插入；发生在其间

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -tion 构成，义为「干预；介入」
由现在分词构成，义为「介于其间的」
同一词根 venire 构成，义为「召集」
同一词根 venire 构成，义为「阻止」

senses.title: Step into a quarrel
senses.definition: to involve oneself in a dispute or bad situation in order to alter the outcome
senses.definitionCN: 为改变结果而置身于争执或坏局面之中
senses.example: A neighbour intervened and pulled the two men apart.
senses.exampleCN: 一位邻居介入，把两个人拉开。
senses.why: Latin venire means to come; to intervene is to come in between other people.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 venire 意为「来」，intervene 就是「走到别人中间来」。

senses.title: Come in as a third force
senses.definition: to act from outside so as to stop or change what two others are doing
senses.definitionCN: 从外部行动以阻止或改变另外两方所做的事
senses.example: The central bank intervened to calm the currency market.
senses.exampleCN: 央行出面干预以稳定货币市场。
senses.why: Institutions borrow the quarrel sense for markets and states.
senses.whyCN: 机构把劝架义借到市场与国家事务上。

senses.title: Come between in time
senses.definition: to occur between two points in time so as to separate them
senses.definitionCN: 发生在两个时点之间，把它们隔开
senses.example: Two wars intervened before the treaty was signed.
senses.exampleCN: 条约签订之前隔着两场战争。
senses.why: The literal coming-between survives here with no one acting at all.
senses.whyCN: 这里保留字面上的「来到中间」，却没有任何人动手。

senses.title: Happen in between
senses.definition: to lie or happen between two other things in space or in a sequence
senses.definitionCN: 在空间上或次序上位于另外两事物之间
senses.example: A narrow lane intervenes between the two gardens.
senses.exampleCN: 两座花园之间夹着一条窄巷。
senses.why: Space and sequence keep the oldest, most neutral use of the word.
senses.whyCN: 空间与次序保留了这个词最古老、最中性的用法。

intro.en: Intervene joins Latin inter- "between" with venire "to come".
intro.cn: intervene 把拉丁语 inter-「之间」与 venire「来」结合在一起。

items.en: Venire meant to come or to approach.
items.cn: venire 意为来到或走近。

items.en: Intervenire meant to come in between or to interrupt.
items.cn: intervenire 意为走到中间来或插进来。

items.en: French intervenir kept the legal sense of a third party stepping in.
items.cn: 法语 intervenir 保留了第三方出面的法律义。

items.en: English law used intervene for a party joining a suit.
items.cn: 英国法律用 intervene 指当事人加入诉讼。

items.en: Politics and medicine widened it to any outside action.
items.cn: 政治与医学又把它扩展到任何外部行动。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -vene root of coming; the near-meaning group holds other words for stepping in.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -vene「来」词根；近义组收其他表示「出面」的词。

entries.definition: The act of stepping in from outside.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「干预」。

entries.definition: To call people together to meet.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「召集」。

entries.definition: To come before and stop something.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「阻止」，字面是「先来」.

entries.definition: To get involved where one is not wanted.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「干涉」，常含不受欢迎之意。

entries.definition: To help two sides reach agreement.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「调解」，居中促成和解。

entries.definition: To take action to help or stop something.
entries.definitionCN: 动词短语义为「出面」，偏口语。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the coming verb venire, which is hidden in many English words.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子用「来」这个动词 venire，它藏在许多英语词里。

normal.en: inter- between plus venire come equals coming between.
normal.cn: inter-「之间」加 venire「来」等于「来到中间」。

normal.en: Convene and prevent carry the same coming root.
normal.cn: convene 与 prevent 带着同一个「来」的词根。

normal.en: To intervene in a quarrel is to arrive where you were not invited.
normal.cn: intervene in a quarrel 是来到一个没人请你的地方。

normal.en: The bank intervened, the referee intervened: both step in.
normal.cn: 银行介入、裁判介入，都是 step in。

normal.en: Two years intervened before they met again.
normal.cn: 他们再见面之前隔了两年。

abstract.en: Intervention is a hand laid on someone else's story.
abstract.cn: 干预是一只手搭在别人的故事上。

abstract.en: The intervener chooses sides by merely arriving.
abstract.cn: 介入者只要到场，就已经选了边。

abstract.en: Some years merely pass; others intervene.
abstract.cn: 有些年份只是过去，有些则横在中间。

examples.en: The referee intervened when the players began pushing.
examples.cn: 球员开始推搡时裁判介入了。

examples.en: Several quiet years intervened before the letters came.
examples.cn: 来信之前隔了好几个平静的年头。

examples.en: Doctors intervened in time to save his sight.
examples.cn: 医生及时干预，保住了他的视力。

dict_mnemonic.text: inter（之间）+ ven（来）+ e——走到中间来

root: 拉丁语 venire「来」→ intervenire「来到中间」→ 古法语 intervenir → 英语 intervene。同族有 intervention、convene、prevent。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: step into a quarrel, act as an outside force, come between in time, and lie in between.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：介入争执、作为第三方出面、在时间上隔在中间，以及空间上夹在中间。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand pushed in between two people who are shouting.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手臂伸进两个正在大声争吵的人之间。

branches.en: THE NEIGHBOUR: someone arrives and pulls them apart.
branches.cn: 邻居这条线：有人来到中间把人拉开。

branches.en: THE BANK: an institution acts from outside.
branches.cn: 银行这条线：机构从外部动手。

branches.en: THE CALENDAR: empty years sit between two dates.
branches.cn: 日历这条线：两个日期之间隔着几年。

branches.en: THE LANE: a narrow path squeezed between gardens.
branches.cn: 小巷这条线：被两座花园夹住的路。

branches.en: THE LINK: both senses need an outsider to arrive.
branches.cn: 连接线：两个义项都需要一个外来者到场。

intro.en: Intervene is inter- "between" plus the Latin verb venire "to come".
intro.cn: intervene 是 inter-「之间」加拉丁动词 venire「来」。

latinIntro.en: Latin venire, intervenire and the participle interventus are all recorded.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 venire、intervenire 与分词 interventus 均有记载。

items.example: It marks the middle position.
The root also appears in invent and event.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也见于 invent 与 event。

items.example: The verb is the base of the root.
The verb is the direct source.
It forms intervention.
It forms convene, to come together.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 convene，意为聚到一起。

items.example: It forms prevent, to come before.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 prevent，意为先来一步。

items.example: It forms the adjective intervening.

definition_en: the act of becoming involved in a situation from outside, especially to change or stop it
core_image: 会议桌旁原本两方对坐，忽然多出一把椅子放在正中
scene: 两国谈判陷入僵局，第三方派出代表带着折中方案来到桌边。Early medical intervention saved the patient's hand.
sceneCN: 这里 intervention 是「干预、介入」（第 1 个义项：外部力量插手），句意为早期医疗介入保住了病人的手。画面里的物件：折中方案、多出的一把椅子、病历。

pos.zh: 名词：干预；介入；调停

derivatives.zh: 去后缀构成，义为「干预；介入」
加 -ist 构成，义为「干预主义者」
加 -al 构成，义为「介入性的」

senses.title: An act from outside
senses.definition: action taken by a person, group, or state to alter a situation it is not directly part of
senses.definitionCN: 由个人、团体或国家对本不直接属于自己的一方局面采取的、意在改变它的行动
senses.example: The court's intervention ended the strike.
senses.exampleCN: 法院的介入结束了罢工。
senses.why: Latin interventio named the act of coming in between, and the noun keeps it as a thing.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 interventio 指「来到中间」这个动作，名词把它变成一件事。

senses.title: Steps taken to help
senses.definition: professional action taken to improve a person's health, education, or safety
senses.definitionCN: 为改善某人的健康、教育或安全而采取的专业行动
senses.example: Early intervention helps children with hearing problems.
senses.exampleCN: 早期介入对听力有问题的孩子很有帮助。
senses.why: Medicine and teaching softened the word: intervention can be care rather than force.
senses.whyCN: 医学与教育让这个词变软：介入不必是强制，也可以是照护。

senses.title: Stopping a fight
senses.definition: the act of stepping into a conflict in order to separate the parties or end it
senses.definitionCN: 进入冲突以分开双方或结束冲突的行为
senses.example: His intervention stopped the quarrel before anyone was hurt.
senses.exampleCN: 他的介入让争吵在人受伤前就停了。
senses.why: The quarrel picture is the oldest one: someone comes between two raised fists.
senses.whyCN: 劝架的图像最古老：有人走到两只举起的手之间。

intro.en: Intervention is the Latin action noun on intervenire, to come in between.
intro.cn: intervention 是建立在 intervenire（来到中间）上的拉丁语动作名词。

items.en: Venire meant to come; intervenire meant to come between.
items.cn: venire 意为「来」，intervenire 意为「来到中间」。

items.en: Interventio was used for a coming in between two events.
items.cn: interventio 用于指两个事件之间的插入。

items.en: French intervention carried the sense into legal procedure.
items.cn: 法语 intervention 把这个意思带入法律程序。

items.en: English used it for a third party entering a case.
items.cn: 英语用它指第三方进入案件。

items.en: Modern states and clinics made it a term of policy and care.
items.cn: 现代国家与诊所使它成为政策与医疗用语。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -vent- coming stem; the near-meaning group holds other words for stepping in.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -vent-「来」词干；近义组收其他表示插手的词。

entries.definition: The verb of coming in between.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「干预」。

entries.definition: One who favours stepping in.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「干预主义者」。

entries.definition: Something newly thought up.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「发明」，拼写相近。

entries.definition: Unwanted meddling in another's affairs.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「干涉」，多含贬义。

entries.definition: Helping two sides settle a dispute.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「调解」，重在促成和解。

entries.definition: The state of taking part in something.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「参与」，语气中性。

normalIntro.en: These hooks place the word at the moment an extra chair appears at the table.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把它放在「桌边忽然多出一把椅子」的那一刻。

normal.en: -tion turns intervene into a countable act.
normal.cn: -tion 把 intervene 变成可数的行为。

normal.en: Early intervention is the phrase doctors and teachers share.
normal.cn: early intervention 是医生和老师共用的说法。

normal.en: Government intervention changes markets from outside.
normal.cn: government intervention 从外部改变市场。

normal.en: The word keeps venire, the coming of convene and prevent.
normal.cn: 这个词保留 venire，即 convene 与 prevent 里的「来」。

normal.en: Intervention arrives before anyone has asked for it.
normal.cn: intervention 往往在没人开口请求时就到了。

abstract.en: Intervention is a third hand on a two-hand knot.
abstract.cn: 干预是第三只手去解两个人的结。

abstract.en: To intervene is to decide that waiting is no longer a plan.
abstract.cn: 介入等于判定：再等下去已不算计划。

abstract.en: The kindest intervention can look like an interruption.
abstract.cn: 最善意的介入也可能像一次打断。

examples.en: The report called for intervention by the health ministry.
examples.cn: 报告呼吁卫生部介入。

examples.en: Without prompt intervention the injury would have worsened.
examples.cn: 若不及时介入，伤势会更严重。

examples.en: Their intervention in the market was widely criticised.
examples.cn: 他们对市场的干预受到广泛批评。

dict_mnemonic.text: intervene（走到中间）+ tion（名词）——插到中间这件事

root: 拉丁语 venire「来」→ intervenire「来到中间」→ interventio「介入」→ 古法语 → 英语 intervention。同族有 intervene、convention、prevention。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: outside action, professional help, and stepping into a conflict.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：外部行动、专业救助，以及进入冲突把人拉开。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an extra chair placed at the middle of a table set for two.
core.cn: 核心意象：为两人摆好的桌子正中多出的一把椅子。

branches.en: THE COURT: an outside power changes the outcome.
branches.cn: 法院这条线：外部力量改变结果。

branches.en: THE CLINIC: help offered early and on purpose.
branches.cn: 诊所这条线：越早越好的有意帮助。

branches.en: THE FIST: two fighters pulled apart.
branches.cn: 拳头这条线：两个正要动手的人被拉开。

branches.en: THE LINK: both begin with someone not invited in.
branches.cn: 连接线：两个义项都始于一个未被邀请者到场。

branches.en: THE AIM: helping and stopping share the same goal of less harm.
branches.cn: 目标线：救助与制止都指向更少的伤害。

intro.en: Intervention is inter- plus the root vent- "come" and the noun ending -ion.
intro.cn: intervention 由 inter- 加词根 vent-「来」与名词词尾 -ion 构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin interventio and intervenire are recorded members of this family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 interventio 与 intervenire 都是这一族的记载形式。

items.example: It marks the third position.
The root also appears in event and adventure.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也见于 event 与 adventure。

items.example: The noun is the direct source.
It makes an abstract noun.
The verb is the base of the noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是名词的基础。

items.example: It forms interventionist.
It forms interventional.
It builds convention from the same root.
items.exampleCN: 它用同一词根构成 convention。

definition_en: a meeting in which someone is asked questions, either to judge them for a job or to get their views for the public
core_image: 两张椅子面对面摆着，中间只有一台录音机
scene: 写字楼的小间里，桌子两侧各坐一人，桌上摊着一份简历和一支笔。The interview lasted barely twenty minutes.
sceneCN: 这里 interview 是「面试」（第 1 个义项：为判断是否录用而进行的问答），句意为那场面试只持续了不到二十分钟。画面里的物件：简历、录音笔、两张椅子。

pos.zh: 名词：面试；采访；面谈
动词：对……进行面试；采访

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -er 构成，义为「面试官；采访者」
由本词加 -ee 构成，义为「受面试者；受访者」
由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「面试工作；访谈方法」

senses.title: Questions for a job
senses.definition: a formal meeting where an employer asks a candidate questions to judge their suitability
senses.definitionCN: 雇主向候选人提问以判断其是否适合的正式会面
senses.example: Her interview at the bank is on Friday morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她在银行的面试定在周五上午。
senses.why: The prefix inter- means between and videre means to see, so the word first meant seeing each other face to face.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 inter- 意为「之间」，videre 意为「看见」，所以本义是「彼此见面」。

senses.title: Questions for the public
senses.definition: a conversation in which a journalist asks someone questions for print or broadcast
senses.definitionCN: 记者为报刊或广播电视向某人提问的对谈
senses.example: The singer gave a long interview about her new record.
senses.exampleCN: 这位歌手就新专辑接受了一次长采访。
senses.why: Journalism reused the face-to-face meeting and turned it into published words.
senses.whyCN: 新闻业借用这种面对面见面，把它变成发表出来的文字。

senses.title: The verb of asking
senses.definition: to ask someone questions in such a meeting, or to be asked them
senses.definitionCN: 在此类会面中向某人提问，或接受提问
senses.example: They interviewed six people for the post.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为这个职位面试了六个人。
senses.why: English turned the noun into a verb without changing its shape.
senses.whyCN: 英语把这个名词直接转成动词，形式不变。

senses.title: A private talk
senses.definition: a formal private meeting between parties who need to exchange views
senses.definitionCN: 需要交换看法者之间的正式私下会面
senses.example: The minister granted an interview to the delegation.
senses.exampleCN: 部长接见了代表团并与之会谈。
senses.why: The word also keeps its neutral sense of two parties meeting to talk.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也保留了「两方会面交谈」这一中性义。

intro.en: Interview joins Latin inter- "between" and videre "to see": a meeting face to face.
intro.cn: interview 把拉丁语 inter-「之间」与 videre「看见」合起来：一次面对面的会面。

items.en: Entreveue in French meant a meeting where people see each other.
items.cn: 法语的 entreveue 指彼此见面的会晤。

items.en: English borrowed interview in the sixteenth century for a formal meeting.
items.cn: 英语十六世纪借入 interview，指正式会晤。

items.en: Newspapers turned the meeting into a published question-and-answer.
items.cn: 报纸把这种会面变成刊登出来的问答。

items.en: Employers borrowed it for judging job candidates.
items.cn: 雇主借用它指对求职者的考察。

items.en: Broadcasting made the interview a household word.
items.cn: 广播电视让 interview 成为家喻户晓的词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -view root of seeing; the near-meaning group holds kinds of talk.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -view「看见」词根；近义组收各类谈话。

entries.definition: To look again at something in order to judge.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「复查；评论」。

entries.definition: What can be seen, or an opinion.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「景色；看法」。

entries.definition: The person being asked the questions.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「受访者；受面试者」。

entries.definition: An informal talk between people.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「交谈」，语气随意。

entries.definition: A short test performance for a role.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「试演」，偏艺术行当。

entries.definition: A formal session where evidence is heard.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「听证会」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep the face-to-face picture of two people looking at each other.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子守着「两个人面对面看着对方」的画面。

normal.en: inter- between plus view see equals seeing each other.
normal.cn: inter-「之间」加 view「看」就是彼此相见。

normal.en: A job interview is a view of you taken from across a desk.
normal.cn: 求职面试就是隔着桌子取你的一张「看法」。

normal.en: The boss interviews; the candidate is interviewed.
normal.cn: 老板面试别人，候选人被面试。

normal.en: Magazines print the interview as questions and answers.
normal.cn: 杂志把采访印成问答。

normal.en: View also lives in review and preview.
normal.cn: view 也活在 review 与 preview 里。

abstract.en: An interview is a short, formal version of being known.
abstract.cn: 面试是「被了解」这件事的简短正式版。

abstract.en: Two strangers look at each other and call it seeing.
abstract.cn: 两个陌生人互相打量，然后管这叫「看见」。

abstract.en: The room is small because the stakes are large.
abstract.cn: 房间很小，是因为赌注很大。

examples.en: He prepared for the interview by reading the company report.
examples.cn: 他为面试做了准备，读了公司的报告。

examples.en: The paper published a rare interview with the coach.
examples.cn: 报纸刊登了这位教练少有的专访。

examples.en: They will interview three more applicants tomorrow.
examples.cn: 他们明天还要面试另外三名申请者。

dict_mnemonic.text: inter（之间）+ view（看）——彼此当着面看一看

root: 拉丁语 inter「之间」+ videre「看见」→ 古法语 entreveue「会面」→ 英语 interview。同族有 interviewer、interviewee、review。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: a job interview, a media interview, the verb of asking, and a formal private meeting.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：求职面试、媒体采访、提问这个动作，以及正式私下会晤。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two chairs facing each other with nothing but a recorder between.
core.cn: 核心意象：两张面对面的椅子，中间只放一台录音机。

branches.en: THE DESK: an employer weighs a candidate.
branches.cn: 办公桌这条线：雇主掂量候选人。

branches.en: THE MICROPHONE: a journalist gathers words for print.
branches.cn: 话筒这条线：记者为刊登收集话语。

branches.en: THE QUESTION: the act of asking itself.
branches.cn: 问题这条线：提问这个动作。

branches.en: THE DOOR: a formal private meeting of two sides.
branches.cn: 门口这条线：两方的正式私下会面。

branches.en: THE LINK: both are controlled talk with a purpose.
branches.cn: 连接线：两者都是有目的、被掌控的谈话。

intro.en: Interview is inter- "between" plus the Latin root vid- "see", with the French participle ending.
intro.cn: interview 是 inter-「之间」加拉丁词根 vid-「看见」，词尾来自法语分词。

latinIntro.en: Latin videre is recorded, and French entreveue is its medieval meeting form.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 videre 有记载，法语 entreveue 是它中世纪的会面形式。

items.example: It marks the mutual position.
items.exampleCN: 它标出相互之间的位置。

items.example: The root also appears in vision and evident.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也见于 vision 与 evident。

items.example: The verb is the base of the root.
The French noun is the direct source.
items.exampleCN: 这个法语名词是直接来源。
